content.text: Flag default-on in production after support dogfood; closing.
Reassigning many cards today means opening each card or using a brittle CSV round-trip. Ops teams running sprint cleanup need a multi-select path that does not leave the board.

When two or more cards are selected, the multi-select toolbar gains “Reassign…”, opening a member picker. Confirm calls POST /boards/{id}/cards/bulk-reassign with card_ids and assignee_id (or null to unassign). Activity feed records one bulk event plus per-card assignee history.
Done when selection of 50 cards reassigns within 3s on a median board, permissions mirror single-card assign rules, and partial failures return which card_ids were skipped.
